title: rhamnus lycioides subsp. atlantica
intro: Rhamnus lycioides subsp. atlantica, commonly known as the "Atlantic Frangula", is a plant species belonging to the family Rhamnaceae. It is traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues, including digestive problems, inflammation, and infections, due to its health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Rhamnus lycioides subsp. atlantica include laxative and anti-inflammatory effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including anthraquinones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. These compounds contribute to its therapeutic potential in treating conditions such as constipation, diarrhea, and inflammatory diseases.
